commit: feat: auto resize card if rank is hidden

truth.description: The width is measured on the default title after translations.js has run the name through encodeHTML, so each non-ASCII letter of a name such as José counts as an entity like é and the shrunk card comes out wider than the title it shows.

distractions.why: Addition is commutative, so naming the accumulator cur and the item acc still sums every character width.
